### What happens to your word

1. A maintainer reads every offer before it is shown to anyone else.
2. Once it's cleared, your word joins the Legesher language corpus as an option for that term, along with your reasoning. Every word offered is kept, including the ones a pack doesn't choose.
3. Reviewers who speak the language endorse the words they would teach. When a language has enough review, its pack is released again with the community's words.

You're anonymous by default. [Your contributions and your data](https://github.com/legesher/legesher/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR_PRIVACY.md#credit) explains how credit works.
